svg.aria-label: How InstaReply Bot works: DM arrives, notification listener catches it, AI writes the reply, sent via Instagram's reply action or the accessibility fallback. One reply per message, guaranteed.

g.text: Fires Instagram’s own Reply-action with AI text —
exactly like tapping Reply in the shade, automated.
● works in background · screen off · no typing
Opens the chat, types once, taps Send once —
never double-sends, never re-types after a send.
used only when Instagram omits the Reply action
same sender + message ignored within a minute
a sent reply is remembered for 10 min, across restarts
the accessibility fallback can never fire a 2nd send
